title: the picture of the site is the picture of its source
intent: The ninth part of the catch-up plan D4 and the second part of the pair that puts the diagrams where a reader sees them.  The wave D3 put the eight pictures of the architecture on the page of the site, and the wave D2 drew them, but nothing held the two together: a diagram of `site/diagrams/' could be changed, or the code of the machine of the states could be changed, and the picture that the site publishes would keep standing there, telling the reader a truth that is no longer true.  A picture that is quietly out of date is worse than a missing picture, because the reader cannot see that it is missing.  This wave adds the check `tests/checks/check-site-diagrams-current.sh', which draws every diagram of the tree of the sources again in both of its themes, writes the source of the diagram of the state machine out of the code of the kernel, and compares the picture of the render with the picture of the site.  The comparison is a comparison of pictures and not of bytes: both pictures go into one canonical form that drops the noise of a picture (the metadata of the render, the order of the attributes of a tag, the whitespace) and keeps its content (the names of the tags, their order, the colours, the texts, the geometry), and the check proves its own normalizer by numbers: the noise must differ in no line, the colour, the text and the element must differ.  The tree of the repository is never written: the sources are copied into a temporary tree, the render and the comparison happen there, and the trap of the check removes it.  The claim of the wave is new (`the-diagram-on-the-site-is-current').
objection: The check measures the picture of the site against the picture of its source, and nothing else.  (a) **The check does not measure the page**: that is the wave D3 (`the-site-shows-the-diagrams-of-the-architecture').  (b) **The check does not measure that there are exactly two pictures for a diagram and no extra ones**: that is `check-the-diagram-pipeline-renders-both-themes.sh'.  (c) **The check does not measure that the committed file of the source of the machine of the states is the source that the code writes**: it writes the source out of the code itself and compares the picture with that; the freshness of the committed file is `the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code'.  (d) **The check needs Emacs and PlantUML**: without them it answers 3 and not 0, and it says which of the two is missing.  (e) **The canonical form is a decision, not a fact**: it keeps the names of the tags, their order, the colours, the texts and the geometry, and it drops the metadata of the render, the order of the attributes and the whitespace; a difference that the canonical form does not see is a difference the check does not see, and the check proves the boundary of its own normalizer by numbers (0 / 2 / 2 / 1) instead of by assertion.  (f) **The bytes of the picture are not compared**: the byte-for-byte comparison of the sixteen pictures was measured once by the writer of the wave and is true on this tree, but it is not what the check promises.
refuted_by: a picture of the site is not the picture of its source, or a picture of the site is missing, or the source of the diagram of the state machine is not written out of the code of the kernel, or the canonical form drops the colour of a picture, or the canonical form drops the text of a picture, or the canonical form drops the elements of a picture, or the canonical form keeps the noise of a picture, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The writer of the wave did the check; the parent did the claim of it, the record of the wave and the decision that the check lives in `tests/checks/' and not in a script of the writer.  **Measured by the writer (2026-11-22, on copies of the tree)**: the honest tree -- code 0, eight diagrams, sixteen pictures of sixteen; a step added to `site/diagrams/one-turn.puml' without a new render -- code 1, the refusal names `one-turn-light.svg' and `one-turn-dark.svg'; a picture of the site deleted -- code 1, the refusal names the missing file; the code of the machine of the states changed in `lib/yeah-loop.el' without a new render -- code 1, the refusal names `state-machine-light.svg' and `state-machine-dark.svg', which proves that the branch that writes the source out of the code is alive and not decorative; a comment added to a source -- code 0, because the canonical form drops the metadata of the render; PlantUML out of reach -- code 3 and not 0; the tree of the sources absent -- code 2; a source without `@startuml' -- code 2; the tree of the repository not written by the check -- `git status --porcelain' empty and no temporary tree left behind.  **Measured by the parent (2026-11-22, on copies of the tree in `/tmp', independently of the writer)**: the honest tree -- code 0, eight diagrams, sixteen pictures of sixteen; a step added to `site/diagrams/one-turn.puml' without a new render -- code 1, the refusal names `site/assets/diagrams/one-turn-light.svg' and `site/assets/diagrams/one-turn-dark.svg' against the source `site/diagrams/one-turn.puml', fourteen of sixteen pictures compared; the **code** of the machine of the states changed in `lib/yeah-loop.el' (the cell `continue' renamed) without a new render -- code 1, the refusal names `state-machine-light.svg' and `state-machine-dark.svg' -- this is the control that the check compares the picture with the picture of the code and not only with the file of the repository; the control of the claim (`sed -i 's|:the call is refused|:the call is turned away|' site/diagrams/one-turn.puml') -- code 1, the refusal names the two pictures of that source, and the five neighbouring checks (`check-the-one-turn-diagram-shows-the-turn-of-the-agent.el', `check-every-diagram-points-at-files-that-exist.el', `check-the-layer-diagram-points-at-files-that-exist.el', `check-the-site-shows-the-diagrams.el', `check-the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code.sh') stay green on the same tree -- the control breaks this claim alone.  **A defect the measurement found in the check of the writer and not in the page**: the canonical form lost the name of the closing tag (`</text>' became `<>'), so two pictures that closed different elements would have compared equal; the name of the closing tag is kept now, and the offset of the parser was fixed.  **The decision of the parent (2026-11-22; a rule outside §17.2, the owner may cancel it)**: the check writes the source of the machine of the states out of the code and not out of the file of the repository -- the alternative (read the committed file) is one line and the owner may ask for it; the branch that compares the picture with the picture of the code is the one that keeps the promise of the wave, and the freshness of the committed file stays with the claim `the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code'.  **The gate of the wave was not run**: the gate of the package of the waves D3, D4 and E is one gate, and it runs at the end of the package.
